description:
1200W Motor with Peak Power of 3000W
The Likebike Thunder electric bike is equipped with a powerful1200W motor, capable of delivering a peak output of3000Wfor short bursts, ensuring thrilling acceleration and a top speed of 28mph. With an impressive torque of140 N.M, it is exceptionally suited for conquering steep terrains, effortlessly handling inclines ranging from35° to 45°. Its quick and stable performance guarantees an exhilarating and dynamic riding experience every time.
48V50AH High-Capacity Battery
Equipped with a48V50Ahhigh-capacity battery, the Likebike Thunder delivers impressive power and an astounding154 milerange in pedal-assist mode. Our batteries use high-qualityUL-certifiedcells and are equipped with an advanced battery management system (BMS) to effectively prevent overcharging, over-discharging and short-circuiting. They undergo rigorous assembly processes and multiple safety tests (including drop, vibration and high temperature tests) to ensure they are safe and reliable in all scenarios and are widely trusted by users. Fully charging in just3-5 hours, it’s perfect for long-distance rides or daily commutes. With exceptional range and design, it ensures a worry-free riding experience.
Dual Rear Suspension Systems
Inspired by motorcycle suspension design, the dual rear shocks offer superior comfort and stability. With two shock absorbers, the system effectively handles bumps, delivering a smoother ride. Whether on asphalt, dirt, or rocky trails, this design ensures optimal performance and a more controlled ride.
Quad Piston Hydraulic Brakes
Equipped with 180mm x 2.3mm front and rear hydraulic disc brakes, featuringfour-piston brake calipers. This setup ensures powerful and precise stopping power, enhancing safety and control, whether you're riding on smooth roads or tackling rough trails.
LCD Color Display
A clear, easy-to-read display, providing essential riding information at a glance. Whether you're tracking speed, battery level, or riding mode, the bright and responsive screen ensures you stay informed for a better riding experience.
20*4.5 Fat tire
Custom-built fat tires for e-bikes: ideal for daily commutes on paved roads, and ready for mud, mountains and off-road fun on weekends.
